verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside SavvyCal. The MCP connection lets outside AI clients such as Claude or ChatGPT work with calendar data from a chat, which is an external integration rather than an in-product AI capability. Ranked availability windows and scheduling-near-other-meetings nudges are rule-based scheduling features, not AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
